name: Exploration Romance
source:
Exploration Romance Visual Novel is a romance game where you will explore towns, fields and various areas and date with attractive characters. The areas are huge and you decide where to go. As you explore, you will encounter several events and people. You will have multiple choices what to do or what to talk. Depending on your choices, the story leads to different routes and personalized story will unfold.

You will meet many people. Each of them has different personality and as you talk with them, you will know what kind of people they are. Here is where the romance system comes in. Your choices will determine your relationships with the characters and depending on your choices, the relationship may lead to a romantic one. You decide who your favorite character is and you will date with your favorite character.

Although the main focus of the game is on romance, the game offers other aspects as well. Each character has a dream and you can help them to achieve their dreams. Plus, the world in the game has many secrets and you will explore the world and find secrets and by utilizing correct decisions you will solve them. As you discover secrets, you will know more about the world.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1853737400/exploration-romance-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
《Exploration Romance Visual Novel》是一款恋爱游戏。你将探索城镇、原野及各种区域，与富有魅力的角色约会。各个区域十分广阔，去哪里由你决定。探索途中，你会邂逅不同的人，遭遇各种事件，也能选择采取什么行动、谈论什么话题。故事将随你的选择进入不同路线，展开属于你的专属剧情。

你会认识许多人，每个人都有不同的性格。随着交谈，你将逐渐了解他们。这时，恋爱系统便会发挥作用。你的选择将决定与角色之间的关系，也可能让彼此发展为恋人。由你决定最喜欢谁，并与心仪的角色约会。

虽然游戏以恋爱为主，也提供了其他内容。每位角色都有梦想，你可以帮助他们实现。此外，游戏世界中还藏着许多秘密。你将通过探索发现这些秘密，并运用恰当的选择解开谜团。随着秘密逐一揭晓，你也会更加了解这个世界。

[摘自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1853737400/exploration-romance-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]
